cases.sentence: Помните день, когда вы вышли из ___, из земли рабства.
cases.translation: Remember the day when you came out of Egypt, out of the land of bondage.
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: The Lord brought you out from there by a strong hand.
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the means (by a strong hand).

cases.sentence: В тот день пусть каждый скажет своему ___.
cases.translation: On that day let each one tell his son.
cases.explain: The verb сказать (to tell someone) takes its addressee in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Этот обычай будет вам как памятка на ___.
cases.translation: This custom will be to you as a reminder on the forehead.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Бог повел народ в обход пустынной дорогой к Красному ___.
cases.translation: God led the people around by the desert road toward the Red Sea.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Израилетяне ушли из Египта вооруженные для ___.
cases.translation: The Israelites left Egypt armed for battle.
cases.explain: The preposition для governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: For the firstborn of a donkey bring a redemption, a lamb.
cases.explain: The preposition за (in exchange for) governs the accusative; for an animate noun it equals the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Днем Господь шел впереди них в облачном ___.
cases.translation: By day the Lord went before them in a pillar of cloud.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Сегодня в месяце Авив вы уходите.
reading.question: In which month were the people leaving?
reading.explain: The text says 'Сегодня в месяце Авив вы уходите' (today, in the month Abib, you are leaving).

reading.ru: Когда фараон отпустил народ, Бог не повел их через землю филистимлян, хотя так было ближе.
reading.question: What is said about the route through the land of the Philistines?
options: It was the nearer way, but God did not lead them through it
It was the longest way to Canaan
It was free of any enemies
It led straight back to Egypt
reading.correct: It was the nearer way, but God did not lead them through it
reading.explain: The text says God did not lead them through Philistine land 'хотя так было ближе' (although it was nearer).

reading.ru: Бог повел народ в обход пустынной дорогой к Красному морю.
reading.question: Which way did God lead the people?
options: Around by the desert road toward the Red Sea
reading.correct: Around by the desert road toward the Red Sea
reading.explain: The text says God led them 'в обход пустынной дорогой к Красному морю' (around by the desert road to the Red Sea).

reading.ru: Оставив Суккот, они расположились лагерем в Ятаме, на краю пустыни.
reading.question: Where did the people camp after leaving Succoth?
options: In Etham, at the edge of the wilderness
reading.correct: In Etham, at the edge of the wilderness
reading.explain: The text says they camped 'в Ятаме, на краю пустыни' (in Etham, at the edge of the wilderness).

reading.ru: Ни облачный столб днем, ни огненный столб ночью ни разу не отошли от народа.
reading.question: What is said about the pillars of cloud and fire?
options: They never departed from the people
reading.correct: They never departed from the people
reading.explain: The text says neither pillar 'ни разу не отошли от народа' (never departed from the people).

reading.ru: Каждый первенец мужского пола из вашего скота принадлежит Господу.
reading.question: To whom does every firstborn male of the livestock belong?
reading.explain: The text says every firstborn male of the livestock 'принадлежит Господу' (belongs to the Lord).
